questions.text: Write about the banking in Karnataka.
questions.text_as_printed: Write about the banking in Karnataka. (A)

answer.value:
Banking Sector in Karnataka:
Sir M. Visvesvaraya established the State Bank of Mysore in 1913.
Dakshina Kannada and Udupi are considered the cradle of banking.
Canara Bank was the first to sponsor a Regional Rural Bank (RRB) in Karnataka.
12 public sector banks, 16 private commercial banks, and RRBs operate in Karnataka.
